gaps.explanation: p8 Statement of Revenues, Expenses, and Changes in Net Position - Proprietary Funds prints enterprise columns Electric Fund, Water Fund, Sewer Fund, Transfer Station (Internal Service Fund column excluded); no business-type lines in detail[]. JSON receipts = total operating revenues 11,361,044 (User charges, Hookup fees, Other revenue) + Interest income 641,090 + Gain on disposal of capital assets 11,690. Electric 8,094,481 + 66,770 + 438,313 + 11,690 = 8,611,254; Water 1,313,063 + (250) + 41,948 + 101,373 = 1,456,134; Sewer 1,818,143 + (219) + 13,908 + 100,719 = 1,932,551; Transfer Station 1,200 + 12,000 + 685 = 13,885. Sum 12,013,824 = statement total. Negative hookup fees are printed as (250) and (219).
